title: Run the cold computer readiness feasibility test
description:
Run Test 2 from docs/FEASIBILITY_TESTS.md and report the distribution for each readiness gate.

Acceptance criteria:
- Measure cold Fargate task submission, RUNNING, model-call ready, workspace hydrated, and Chromium ready.
- Repeat about five times and identify cache effects.
- Compare warm local Docker.
- Record Chromium absence as an incomplete component rather than hiding it.
- Move roadmap priorities according to the documented result bands.
- Do not optimize during the measurement.
